project.title: Microbial community analysis of granules in upflow anaerobic sludge blanket reactor
project.description: To elucidate the difference among granule microbial communities in UASB reactors, we attempted to analyze individual granule microbial communities using single-granule-level approach.
project.center_name: National Institute of Technology, Kitakyushu College
